title: AgentState
description: Runtime schema for the CAGE governed financial advisor LangGraph AgentState TypedDict. Source of truth: src/governed_financial_advisor/graph/state.py. Any change to AgentState MUST be reflected here within the same PR.

messages.description: Shared conversation history. Annotated with add_messages reducer. Items are LangChain BaseMessage objects serialised as dicts at the boundary.

next_step.description: Routing control — the next node the supervisor selects.

risk_status.description: Risk loop control — outcome of the evaluator's risk assessment.

risk_feedback.description: Free-text feedback from the evaluator when risk_status is REJECTED_REVISE.

loop_count.description: Recursion depth counter for the evaluator safety breaker. Incremented unconditionally in execution_analyst_node. Graph breaks to explainer at loop_count >= 3.

safety_status.description: OPA pre-trade gate outcome set by safety_check_node.

governance_signature.description: Cryptographic-style approval string generated by evaluator_node after a successful governance check.

reasoning_output.description: Thinker node output — the reasoning chain passed to the Doer.

execution_plan_output.description: Structured execution plan from execution_analyst_node. May be a JSON string or a parsed dict.

data_analyst_ticker.description: Ticker symbol identified by the data analyst planner. Forwarded to governed_trader_graph for TOCTOU re-hydration.

evaluation_result.description: Evaluator verdict and simulation results (CAGE System 3 control signal).

opa_results.description: Detailed OPA policy engine outputs for the auditor.

governance_summary.description: Final auditor report string surfaced to the UI.

user_id.description: User identity — ISO 42001 A.7.2 accountability attribution. Must be non-empty.

latency_stats.description: Cumulative per-node latency in seconds. Used by the Bankruptcy Protocol.

completed_transactions.description: Saga transaction ledger (Write-Ahead Log). Append-only via operator.add reducer. Sorted by sequence_id DESC for LIFO rollback. MUST be filtered before passing state to LLM-backed nodes.

approval_required.description: HITL gate flag. True when trade value > $10k OR risk_score > 0.7. Default false.

approval_decision.description: Human approval decision dict. Schema: {approved: bool, reviewer: str, rationale: str, comment: str, timestamp: str}.

hitl_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC TTL expiration timestamp for the pending HITL approval state.

guardrail_blocked.description: Set True by nemo_guardrail_node when the input rail blocks. Graph routes to END immediately. Default false.

guardrail_reason.description: Block reason string from nemo_guardrail_node. Empty string when not blocked.

output_rail_applied.description: Set True by nemo_output_rail_node after output screening/masking. Auditors assert this is True on every non-blocked trace. Default false.
